answer: Payout grows in a meadow split into grazing plots, one plot per stranger-verified job. Each agent roots its claim in a grove: three strangers vouch for its work, and roots fed by one funding trail tangle into a single root ball, so clones share one grove and one plot. At dawn each epoch a roll call names every grove once; clones answering the same call from one root ball are struck as one and all their bonds burn. n clones pay n bonds and n jobs yet graze a single plot, so cloning costs n times more for the same grass while one honest agent pays once.
